entities.name: Torsten Von Ursus
entities.description: A legendary human soldier of Dominaria who founded Benalia and died at seventy-two.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation Torsten built from the blighted city of Benfosa.

entities.name: Sheoltun Empire
entities.description: Once-great empire from whose ruins Torsten led Benalia's ancestors.

entities.name: Lost Edict
entities.description: Edict leaving Benalia to his seven lieutenants.

events.summary: Torsten leaves the Knights of Jenges after a mage claims the throne of Wrenna and travels southwest.
events.quote: After a terrible mage claimed the throne of Wrenna he left the order and traveled southwest.

events.summary: Torsten studies minotaur philosophy for several years.
events.quote: entered the dread land of the minotaurs to study minotaur philosophy for several years

events.summary: Torsten finds blighted Benfosa and remakes it as Benalia by force of will.
events.quote: he brought an entire nation into being using nothing more than the force of his will

events.summary: Torsten dies at seventy-two, leaving the Lost Edict that gives Benalia to seven lieutenants.
events.quote: he died at the age of seventy-two, leaving behind the legendary Lost Edict

relations.quote: Originally a member of the legendary Knights of Jenges
